records.finding: Added a dated event for distinct microfossil evidence of saccharification, and placed the archaeological observations at the registered Jiahu site. The 2026 and 2004 interpretations use different methods. Coauthor Juzhong Zhang and at least context T14H32 overlap. The same individual sherd has not been identified.

records.finding: Retained the separate Guantaoyuan practice and changed its origin from first known to unknown. Earlier inferred mould-starter brewing at Shangshan and Jiahu makes the earlier priority label untenable. The shared researcher and analytical approach limit independence of interpretations, although the sites and specimens differ.

records.finding: Added a candidate for development from the earlier possible potting turntable at Tell Feres, a genuinely separate Late Ubaid workshop artefact. Kept the later LC2 wheel-coiling dated with diagnostic traces. A gap in documented devices prevents concluding dependence. Earlier Levantine wheel-coiling has clear evidence but no demonstrated route into Mesopotamia.

records.finding: Proposed a distinct local dairy-handling record based on residues in dated pottery contexts. The companion relationship records local use together, as evidenced by the Grey Burnished Ware sherd SAB263. The earliest pottery assemblage at the site provides separate context. Manufacturing provenance and wider continuity remain unresolved.

records.finding: Added site-specific forming evidence from the early slab-built ceramic assemblage. Cooking is possible from exterior marks, while no reviewed residue identifies a particular food or fermentation. Later cave sherds with coiling and paddle impressions are a useful comparison across the sequence; direct descent into Jiahu or Shangshan remains unresolved.
